title: BRO Soil Map — Area of pedological interest
description:
6,192 polygons delimiting the area of pedological interest of the national Soil Map 1:50,000 (Bodemkaart, SGM) — where soil mapping applies. Produced under VRO; bronhouder Wageningen Environmental Research.

🤖 AI/Agent users: see AGENTS.md for field descriptions, query examples and usage tips.

BRO Soil Map — Area of pedological interest documentation

table:columns.name: maparea_id
table:columns.description: Unique ID of this map polygon in the delivered SGM model version (e.g. V2025-1.areaofpedologicalinterrest.NNN).

table:columns.name: maparea_collection
table:columns.description: Soil area collection (bodemvlakcollectie) this polygon belongs to, given by collection kind (SGM cat. 4.3.6.2).

table:columns.name: beginlifespan
table:columns.description: Date/time this version of the spatial object was inserted or changed in the dataset (INSPIRE lifespan; not in SGM catalogus v1.2; null in data).

table:columns.name: endlifespan
table:columns.description: Date/time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired (INSPIRE lifespan; not in SGM catalogus v1.2; null in data).

table:columns.name: pedologicalinterest
table:columns.description: Pedological interest (bodemkundig belang): area type where soil cannot be typed, relevant for interpreting surrounding soils (SGM cat. 4.3.8).

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Feature geometry (WKB) in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New).

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct for spatial filtering.
